listening.title: Khảo sát nhu cầu khách hàng mới

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Thanks for your time today. Can I ask a few questions to assess your current setup?

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Sales Executive)
lines.text: What's the biggest gap between your current system and what you actually need?

lines.speaker: Lan (Procurement Manager)
lines.text: Honestly, our reporting is too slow, and it's hard to track inventory in real time.

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Sales Executive)
lines.text: I see. Let me probe a bit more — how often do you need those reports?

lines.speaker: Lan (Procurement Manager)
lines.text: Daily, ideally. Weekly at the very least.

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Got it. Is custom branding on the dashboard a must-have, or more of a nice-to-have?

lines.speaker: Lan (Procurement Manager)
lines.text: Definitely a nice-to-have. The real priority is speed and accuracy.

lines.speaker: Tuấn (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Thanks, that answers my clarifying question. What's your timeframe for making a decision?

lines.speaker: Lan (Procurement Manager)
lines.text: We'd like to shortlist vendors within two weeks.
